label: B25-ASYNC-FIFO-PAYLOAD-HOLD-AUDIT
title: Enumerate and classify asynchronous FIFO payload hold paths
scope: Use the frozen T-002 final fitted database for report-only queries that enumerate every async FIFO memory/payload path and destination in both directions. Return SDC-fix / RTL-fix / indeterminate with exact minimum future write regions.
